_readme: Presentation-only index of reviewed timeline events that are job advertisements. Matching uses institution, date and source URL; wording is compressed from the cited posting and does not affect classification.

postings.ai_wording: Coordinate embedded AI teams against roadmaps; report ROI through the firm's existing framework; support firm-wide AI training, vendor governance and usage-cost tracking.

postings.role: Lead Platform Engineer, Enterprise Data Platform
postings.ai_wording: The recently launched Enterprise Data Platform is described as the central hub for foundation data and an enabler of AI, with multi-year data and AI roadmaps including agentic AI.
Join an AI-first team building a conversational platform for employees to discover and use connected knowledge, with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and Codex named in the toolset.
Names the internal AI Centre of Excellence as a partner function and discloses possible AI-assisted applicant screening while retaining human decisions.
Identify process improvements and use AI tools to improve the efficiency and scalability of operational due-diligence workflows.
Integrate Azure OpenAI into enterprise applications, build retrieval-augmented generation over approved data, and develop evaluation and monitoring for traceable, responsible deployment.
Requires proficiency applying AI to research, analysis, communication and workflow efficiency, with judgment about accuracy, confidentiality and appropriate use.
Prefers proficiency with tools such as ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot to automate workflows, speed research and improve day-to-day productivity.
